claims: "Boy kibble" is often called the male counterpart to "girl dinner".
"Boy kibble" typically consists of bulk-cooked ground beef, rice, and sometimes vegetables or sauces.
"Boy kibble" typically includes rice and lean protein (ground beef, chicken, or turkey).
"Boy kibble" allows for a $2–$4 per meal price point.
"Boy kibble" often totals 26+ grams of protein per serving.
Variations of "boy kibble" include spices, soy sauce, broccoli, or avocado.
"Boy kibble" is popularized on TikTok and Instagram.
